description: Checks the arithmetic on a restaurant supplier's invoice from its lines as read (item, pack, quantity, unit price, line total): each line's quantity times unit price against its line total, within a cent; the lines plus tax, delivery and other charges against the invoice total; the same item listed twice; and, when earlier prices for the same items from the same supplier are sent, each price change with its amount, percentage and what it adds up to on this invoice. Items are matched by their name's words and pack, with common distributor shorthand spelled out; a name that only looks like an earlier one comes back as a question ("Is line 3 the same item as ...?") rather than a match. Every figure is used exactly as sent; none is filled in. A difference is described as worth asking the supplier about, not as the supplier's mistake. Nothing about the request is stored or counted.

charges.description: Tax, delivery, fuel and other charges or credits printed apart from the items.

amount.description: The charge, negative for a credit, in dollars.

label.description: Such as Sales tax, Delivery fee or Credit.

invoice_total.description: The invoice total as printed; null when there's none.

lines.description: The invoice's item lines, in order.

item.description: The item as printed, such as Chicken thighs boneless.

pack.description: The pack or unit as printed, such as 40 lb case, lb or each.

quantity.description: The quantity billed; null when it isn't printed.

unit_price.description: The price for one pack or unit, in dollars; null when it isn't printed.

previous_prices.description: Earlier unit prices for items from the same supplier, newest first; an item's first entry counts.

item.description: The item as it was on an earlier invoice from the same supplier.

unit_price.description: Its unit price then, in dollars.

name: restaurantdoctor_invoice_check

addsUp.description: True when every checked line adds up, the total matches (or there is none) and no item is listed twice.

difference.description: The line total minus the expected amount.

expected.description: Quantity times unit price, to the cent.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

newItems.description: Items with no earlier price sent.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

notChecked.description: Lines without a quantity or unit price, so their arithmetic wasn't checked.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

change.description: This price minus the earlier one; positive is up.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

anyOf.description: The change times the quantity on this invoice.

per.description: The unit the change is for, in words, such as a case or a pound.

questions.description: Items that only look like an earlier one: the same item or not is the owner's answer.

candidate.description: The earlier item it may be the same as.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

samePrice.description: Items at the same price as before.

line.description: The line's number, from 1, in the order sent.

difference.description: The printed total minus the added amount.

anyOf.description: No invoice total, or a line without a total.
